column1: # One real class-meeting date per line, in chronological order. No day-ids:
# content pages are matched to a date purely by their position in the
# schedule (sorted the same way ScheduleTable displays them), not by a
# hand-typed lookup key. This means canceling a class day is a single-line
# deletion here — every subsequent page's date shifts automatically, with
# no changes needed to any .mdx file. A line can also be a "start..end"
# range (e.g. a week off); it still consumes exactly one position.
